<script>
(function () {
  // Remplit les champs cachés du formulaire de contact : [data-mz-field="source|landing|article"].
  // Ne tourne qu'après l'accord « mesure ». L'origine est gardée le temps de la visite (sessionStorage).
  var KEY = 'mz-origine', d = null;
  try { d = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); } catch (e) {}
  function param(n) { var m = location.search.match(new RegExp('[?&]' + n + '=([^&#]+)')); return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1].replace(/\+/g, ' ')) : ''; }
  if (!d) {
    var src = param('utm_source'), med = param('utm_medium'), host = '';
    if (document.referrer) { var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = document.referrer; host = a.hostname; }
    if (src) src = med ? src + ' / ' + med : src;
    else if (param('gclid')) src = 'google / cpc';
    else if (host && host !== location.hostname) src = host;
    else if (!host) src = 'direct';
    else src = 'non connue';
    d = { source: src, landing: location.pathname, article: '' };
  }
  if (/^\/article\//.test(location.pathname)) d.article = location.pathname;
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {}
  function fill() {
    for (var k in d) {
      var els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-mz-field="' + k + '"]');
      for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) els[i].value = d[k];
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fill); else fill();
})();
</script>
